texts.facts: The petitioner has filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act, claiming compensation of Rs.15,00,000/- for the accidental injuries sustained by him in a road traffic accident took place on 17.05.2023. 2. Due to the forced impact, petitioner fell down and sustained grievous injuries on vital parts of the body. Due to the injuries sustained in the accident the petitioner has become permanently disabled and lost his future income. Respondent being the owner cum internal insurer of the offending vehicle is liable to pay the compensation to the petitioner. 3. After service of notice, the respondent has appeared through his counsel and filed the written statement by denying the contents of the claim petition as false and contended that the petition is neither maintainable in law nor on facts and also denying the rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle.
